BiblicalUsage: David took Metheg-ammah out of the hand of the Philistines after he smote them and subdued them. The name is an epithet of Gath itself, the bridle of the mother city, and its capture marks David's victory over the Philistine stronghold.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the taking of Gath's bridle says what David's reign would be: the Philistines who had held Israel's bridle would hold it no longer.
